title: Route 1 Glitch City walk-off crash
instructions: On the same save copy, after Ruining the Neighborhood: save outside the Safari gate and repeat the Safari exit setup (pay, step back, answer No, save, reset, Continue, decline the new offer, leave south). Fly to Pallet Town, walk north onto Route 1 and let the steps run out there.

Exit the gate south into Route 1’s Glitch City and walk (or Surf) off the map edge until the game really crashes; then reset without saving. A freeze, a softlock or a plain white screen did not count for several players: reset and try again.
Fallback: use a glitch item from the corrupted bag on the Speedrun? copy. Never save after the crash; walking out of bounds can corrupt the save.

title: Empty-save SRAM-corruption route
instructions: On a second renamed ROM copy with an empty save (never the main save): start a new game; names do not matter for the casual routes. The official any% route assumes fixed names and a fixed Trainer ID, which is impractical; pick one tested item-swap recipe and stick to it.

Save right after starting and reset during the save inside a window of about four frames. “Save data destroyed” means slightly early; no CONTINUE means far too early; a broken Pokémon menu means too late. Clear that copy’s save at the title screen (Up+Select+B) and retry; one RetroArch player needed two reset presses around the save. Timing on other cores is unverified.

Follow one tested item-swap recipe, for example the community variant (swap items 9↔10 and 10↔11, scroll to the second Master Ball, toss 138, step south and exit) or a published video recipe. The official any% swap list assumes player RED, rival JOHN and Trainer ID 25794: Take one step down. Swap party positions 11↔12 and 13↔10. In Items swap slot 1 Gold Teeth with slot 5 j.x[38], then slot 3 Gold Teeth with slot 13 j.x[1] below Great Ball. Swap party 17↔22 and 23↔18. Close the menu to reach Hall of Fame.

Reach the Hall of Fame with at most 1:00 on the clock. Record the Hall-of-Fame transition and confirm the hardcore unlock separately; the main set’s speedrun leaderboard may also post a time (harmless).

title: Rare Candy in physical bag slot six
instructions: After protected completion, place Rare Candy ×1 in physical bag slot six. With a verified suitable name-derived MissingNo encounter, watch Viridian old man’s demonstration, Fly to Cinnabar and Surf its east shore. Escape the glitch encounter, inspect 129, toss two to leave 127, repeat the encounter and inspect 255. Keep the candy in slot six throughout.

The seen-bit mechanism ORs quantity with 128: 1|128=129, then 127|128=255. It does not always add 128. Normalize a different starting count to one through ordinary handling and recheck position. Do not catch the glitch species, spend candies, or replace physical order with a sorted bag summary.
Arrange the bag and save first. Do not visit any map with wild Pokémon between the old man and Cinnabar’s east shore.

title: Safari exit into the Pallet Town Glitch City
instructions: On the save copy, with ¥500 and a Fly user: pay to enter the Safari Zone and step straight back into the gate. Answer No when asked whether you are leaving early. Save on the copy, reset and Continue. Walk into the gate, decline the new offer and leave south.

Fly to Pallet Town and walk around outdoors (no buildings, don’t leave town) until the time-up announcement warps you to the Safari gate. Exit the gate south: Pallet has no matching warp, so you land in its Glitch City, the only one that pops this achievement. You cannot move there; wait for the pop, then Fly out.

Never save inside a Glitch City. If you land somewhere else, Fly out and repeat; if anything else goes wrong, reload the last in-game save on the copy. Glitch Cities elsewhere (Cycling Road, Route 24, Indigo Plateau and others) did not pop it in player reports.

evidence.description: Confirm a valid hardcore unlock timestamp from the appropriate account feed.
Observed entry into the Pallet Town Glitch City and a safe Fly exit on the save copy.

title: Special 226 Oak with the unchosen starter
instructions: After protected completion, require an observed Special of 226 and validated encounter transport. Ditto copies the donor; apply successful Growls by player starter: Bulbasaur six (Oak Blastoise), Charmander five (Oak Venusaur), Squirtle four (Oak Charizard). Escape without another encounter, trigger Oak and defeat the correctly observed team. On a finished save every trainer is beaten, so the PC item underflow is the transport.

Oak teams are Tauros L66, Exeggutor L67, Arcanine L68, the correct unchosen evolved starter L69, and Gyarados L70. Observe this roster and win; a different starter victory is insufficient. Keep Growl until both the level jump and correct-roster Oak work are complete.
Don’t use a donor that knows an Attack-raising move: the Transformed Ditto copies it and can undo the Growls. Check Oak’s fourth Pokémon before fighting.
